title: Ask makes a real photo when asked, like a kitten walking in the snow
goal: Typing something like "generate a photo of a kitten walking in the snow" into Ask puts a real, photo-style picture on the canvas as a picture layer, made on this Mac. Today Ask's picture model is only used for drawings, and everything it paints is traced into flat vector shapes, so a photo request can never come back as a photo.
notes:
User, 2026-10-27, intake: "i specifically want to be able to say 'generate a photo of a kitten walking in the snow' and it will do that, for example. I don't know who it was set aside". The last sentence is about MOSS-Image: it was set aside on 2026-10-24 by the intake session's research pass, written into the notes of queue/tasks/p1-high/measure-whether-qwen-image-2-1-can-paint-and-edi.json, NOT by the user. The user never decided it; reconsider it here on measured numbers, not on that note.

What exists: Ask's picture model is Z-Image Turbo q8 on mflux/MLX behind a loopback server (Sources/PhotonzCore/AskPictureModelPlan.swift; docs/design/ask.md 'The picture model', ~line 360). Its output is always traced into vector layers by vtracer (Scripts/picture-model/layers.py) and it only serves add_drawing. There is no tool or route that keeps generated pixels as a picture layer; that is the missing piece, and Z-Image Turbo can probably already make photos, so the first step may be a route plus an untraced landing rather than a new model.

Overlap: the in-progress Qwen-Image-2.1 measuring task is measuring the same model for drawings and editing. Share its numbers, do not measure it twice; whichever lands second reads the other's audit.

Traps: never store or code subjects or example pictures (memory: no hardcoded generated content); the picture model needs ~12 GB resident beside the chat model (AskPictureModelPlan.fits); a pasted pixel layer goes through History.perform like any other layer; pixels live in ImageStore, never in the document model.
acceptance: Asking Ask for a photo ("generate a photo of a kitten walking in the snow", "a photo of a red bicycle against a brick wall") lands one new picture layer holding the generated pixels, untraced, at Next defaults, as one undo step

Asking for a drawing, an icon or an illustration still goes the existing route (painted then traced into editable layers, or the model's own SVG); Ask picks the route from the request itself, never from stored subjects or hardcoded examples

The model is picked on MEASURED numbers on this Mac (64 GB M4 Max) and written into the audit: candidates at least Z-Image Turbo already installed (kept untraced), Qwen-Image-2.1, and MOSS-Image, each with seconds per 1024 px picture, peak memory beside the chat model, and a contact sheet of the same 8 photo prompts (people, animals, food, a landscape, a product shot, text on a sign) so the user can compare by eye
With no picture model on the Mac, a photo request says so in one plain sentence with the Set Up button, and Settings > Ask offers the download with its size

Walk proving the try path: open a blank canvas, Ask for a photo, a picture layer of the asked size lands and its pixels are not a flat or traced fill (measured: distinct colours and edge detail above a bar that today's traced output FAILS)

Audit under queue/audits/ with the contact sheets and numbers; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not
